The overlay was real and is now cleared. The preview server's compiler service had died, so no source change was needed.

**Before:** two Vite servers were running on port 5173. The one on IPv4 (the one the preview uses) had no compiler child process.
- `GET /` returned 200.
- `GET /src/App.tsx`, `/src/components/TradeTab.tsx` and `/api/health` returned 500 with "The service is no longer running".
- The second server, on IPv6 only, served everything with 200. That is why my earlier `localhost` probes passed.

**Action:** I stopped both servers and started a single `bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0`. I changed no files, dependencies or chain state, and ran no tests, build or deploy.

**After** (IPv4, with the preview host header):

| Path | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | 200 |
| `/src/App.tsx` | 200 |
| `/src/components/TradeTab.tsx` | 200 |
| `/api/health` | 200 |

No esbuild error markers in any response. Changed paths: none.

**Sharing, from what I can observe:**
- I have no tool that creates or links a Studio project or workspace URL, so whether Share produces one is unknown.
- My only deploy tool targets Hugging Face. Vercel is reachable only through your Integrations menu, and I can't tell whether it can link the existing `sacred-arc-mvp` project without a second deployment.
- The app's share sync does mirror in-app paths into the studio.arc.io address bar. I haven't confirmed that gives judges a stable public project URL.
- I can't see this continuation thread's URL; take it from the address bar. The app ID you gave is 37c6c8dc-b313-49c9-9cbb-fe5f61673ab3.
